Bhagavad Gita Chapter 3, Verse 39

कर्मयोग

Shlok 39 (sloka 39) of adhyaya 3 — Karma Yoga (कर्मयोग), from the Bhagavad Geeta or Bhagavat Gita (भगवद्गीता). Open in Ask Krishna.

Open this verse in Ask Krishna

Sanskrit (Devanagari)

आवृतं ज्ञानमेतेन ज्ञानिनो नित्यवैरिणा |
कामरूपेण कौन्तेय दुष्पूरेणानलेन च ||३-३९||

English meaning

O Arjuna, wisdom is enveloped by this constant enemy of the wise in the form of desire, which is unappeasable as fire.

Hindi meaning

हे कौन्तेय ! अग्नि के समान जिसको तृप्त करना कठिन है ऐसे कामरूप,  ज्ञानी के इस नित्य शत्रु द्वारा ज्ञान आवृत है।।
